title: CADRAT-3 Pre-Check gate window is commit-counted (HEAD~3), not time-bounded — spans ~2min in a 266-commit/day repo, so the gated primary function is effectively dead code

defect.mechanism: All CADRAT-3 Pre-Check gates ask 'did an in-scope file change in `git diff --name-only HEAD~3..HEAD`?'. HEAD~3 is a COMMIT-COUNT window, not a time window. This repo made 266 commits on 2026-08-25. At agent-father's gate-eval moment the 3-commit window spanned 14:46:14 -> 14:48:10 = 116 seconds. A once-daily cron therefore asks 'did an agent file change in the last ~2 minutes?' and near-always gets no.
defect.consequence: The gated step is the cron's namesake primary function. agent-father's Steps 1-2 (orphan+roster scan via scan-orphans.md) did not run this cycle. code-janitor's Decision-Tree DRY scan reported the same skip today ('0 src/ changes detected -> skipped DRY scan as designed').
defect.why_this_is_not_by_design: The gate was designed to skip idle cycles. It now skips essentially ALL cycles, because commit volume grew after CADRAT-3 landed (2026-08-04). The design intent (skip when nothing changed) and the live behaviour (skip when anything changed more than ~2 minutes ago) have diverged.
